newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn postpones energy talks with opposition.
newsitem.headline: Bonn postpones energy talks with opposition.

text.p: The environment ministry said on Wednesday that talks with opposition leaders aimed at reaching consensus on controversial energy issues had been delayed from the scheduled Friday date.
No new date was set. A round of talks on tax reform between Chancellor Helmut Kohl and opposition Social Democrat (SPD) leader Oskar Lafontaine on Wednesday morning ended in acrimonious disagreement.
An environment ministry spokeswoman said discussions to date had been constructive, but that further clarity was needed before another round.
The two sides have said it may be possible to forge an agreement on storage of nuclear waste.

The SPD, which wants nuclear power to be phased out, hopes the government will build a second waste dump in southern Germany, relieving some of the burden from Gorleben, the site of recent violent clashes between police and demonstrators.
